cases.prompt: Build a small local task board. Use tasks collection with title text, status select Todo/Done, done boolean and due date. Render an editable board grouped by status. Include meaningful behavior tests.
Change this workspace to dark mode and compact density. Preserve existing collections, fields, IDs, records and behavior.
Add a Completion percentage stat using a function with ID completion returning a number 0..100 based on tasks.done. Empty data must return 0. Display its result. Keep existing task functionality.
Highlight overdue tasks on the existing task-board node. A task is overdue only when done is false and its nonempty due date is before today. Keep the task board.
Add a page with ID focus titled Focus, showing tasks with completed tasks filtered out using tasks.done. Preserve the existing task board.

Build a two-question quiz with scoring, progression, result and restart. Questions: 2+2 (4 correct, 5 wrong); sky color (blue correct, green wrong). Use state index (0 based), score, choice; actions choose (event.value), answer, next, restart. Answering twice must not score twice. Include meaningful tests and visible controls.
Create real shared accounts with secure authentication and a cloud database synchronized across devices. These are essential requirements.

Build a local parcel quote calculator. Numeric state weight starts at 0; input action set-weight uses event.value. Function quote returns 0 when weight <=0, otherwise 5 plus 2 times weight. Display quote as a stat. Include input and behavior tests. No payments or network.

note: No inference, no canned results. Live mode requires explicit call/output-token reservation budgets and private keys.
